findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:1163-1172 and packages/main/src/core/validation-evidence-reuse.ts:149-186 — HIGH: validate-file JSON can report status/allPass=fail while the wrapper process exits 0. Persistence passes only the outer ValidationCommandResult into summarizeRoutineCommandExecution, which marks commandExecution PASS solely from exit code; after coverage is complete, reuse then returns an unconditional PASS and launders the prior semantic validation failure. Bind commandExecution eligibility to the parsed validator verdict (or synthesize a failed command receipt when parsed status/allPass is non-pass), and add an integration case for exit 0 + JSON FAIL proving the next call executes rather than reuses.

packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:578-603 — reuse snapshots material dirty paths only once, then the final TOCTOU check re-reads only HEAD. A concurrent uncommitted source/config write after captureEvidenceHashSnapshot leaves HEAD unchanged, so clean remains true and cached PASS can be returned over a dirty workspace. Recheck material dirty/status immediately before accepting reuse (or use the existing snapshot reuse checker) and add a deterministic dirty-state race test; severity high because this can manufacture PASS for unvalidated working-tree code.

packages/main/src/core/validation-evidence-reuse.ts:177-186,246-248 — isReusableCommandPass accepts PASS+complete with any nonnegative commandCount and does not bind it to currentIdentity.commands.length or reject contradictory optionalFailureCount/failureKind fields. Thus malformed evidence claiming commandCount=0 can reuse a 45-command identity without proving any command ran, violating CHK-001/004/005 forged-combination fail-closed requirements. Mechanically validate count equality and the full PASS invariant, with malformed evidence tests; severity high.

docs/requirements/decisions/routine-validation-fresh-pass-reuse.md:43-52 — canonical contract says reuse requires an absolutely clean tracked/untracked worktree, while runtime intentionally permits canonical story-metadata/runtime dirty paths such as owner-lease heartbeat and rejects only material dirty paths. This mismatch obscures the real trust boundary and contradicts the live integration behavior. State the material-clean rule and explicit metadata/runtime allowance; severity medium.

packages/main/src/core/validation-evidence-reuse.ts:184-195,246 — HIGH: isReusableCommandPass accepts complete=true/status=PASS with any nonnegative commandCount but never binds commandCount to currentIdentity.commands.length. A crafted or corrupted receipt can claim commandCount=0 for an identity containing a real failing command and evaluateRoutineValidationReuse returns reusable=true, bypassing execution. Repro: the reviewer built a one-command identity, supplied structured PASS/complete with commandCount=0, and observed {reusable:true}. WHY: CHK-005 adversarial requires forged/contradictory commandExecution to fail closed; require commandCount === current identity command count (and validate count fields) before reuse, with a regression that proves the real command executes.

packages/main/src/tasks/validation-evidence-reuse-smoke.ts:40-136,200-205,319-344 — MEDIUM: the claimed CHK-004 end-to-end matrix is not present. The only real CLI handler test is configured-command with one probe; fallback and validate-file are only passed through the pure identity builder, and the B-19ca 45-command case only calls evaluateRoutineValidationReuse with synthetic evidence instead of executing 45 commands once and then proving zero executions. Injected parse/hash/status/lineage/identity/second-HEAD failures and real locked TOCTOU execution are likewise not exercised. WHY: the evidence note overstates coverage and distinct handler branches can regress despite the helper smoke passing; add real handler executed→reused/fail-closed rows for configured, fallback, validate-file (and no-validator if retained), plus a real 45-command counter and failure seams required by CHK-004.
